surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Hedman wins it in overtime
paras: Ryan Winterton got the scoring started for the Kraken early in the first. Brandon Hagel tied it late in the first. The Kraken’s Brandon Montour left early in the second period and didn’t return. Hagel scored his second of the night early in the second to put the Lightning ahead 2-1. Jared McCann tied it on the power play early in the third. Ilya Mikheyev scored his 100th NHL goal midway through the third to put the Bolts ahead 3-2. Matty Beniers tied it 3-3 with 4:19 left. Victor Hedman won it 2:07 into overtime.

The Lightning had the better of the chances, outshooting the Kraken 35-27. Andrei Vasilevskiy made 24 saves for the Lightning, and Philipp Grubauer stopped 31 of 35. The Lightning moved to 5-2-0, and the Kraken fell to 5-2-1.

items.text: The Kraken’s three-game winning streak is over.
Brandon Hagel extended his point streak against Seattle to at least seven games.
Nikita Kucherov’s five-game point streak against Seattle ended.
Victor Hedman scored his first goal of the season, his first since Feb 28 (15 games played since).
